tasks.label: git-push-main
tasks.command: git --no-pager status --short; Write-Host '---'; git --no-pager push origin main

tasks.label: rewrite-history-remove-env-secrets-bash
tasks.command: bash -lc "FILTER_BRANCH_SQUELCH_WARNING=1 git filter-branch --force --index-filter 'git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch --quiet .env .env.production .env.example .env.production.example backend/.env backend/.env.production backend/.env.example backend/.env.production.example frontend/.env frontend/.env.production frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.production.example' --prune-empty -- --all"

tasks.label: rewrite-history-remove-env-secrets-pwsh
tasks.command: $env:FILTER_BRANCH_SQUELCH_WARNING='1'; git filter-branch --force --index-filter "git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch --quiet -- .env .env.production .env.example .env.production.example backend/.env backend/.env.production backend/.env.example backend/.env.production.example frontend/.env frontend/.env.production frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.production.example" --prune-empty -- --all

tasks.label: rewrite-history-with-git-filter-repo
tasks.command: py -m pip install --user git-filter-repo; git filter-repo --path .env --path .env.production --path .env.example --path .env.production.example --path backend/.env --path backend/.env.production --path backend/.env.example --path backend/.env.production.example --path frontend/.env --path frontend/.env.production --path frontend/.env.example --path frontend/.env.production.example --invert-paths --force

tasks.label: run-git-filter-repo-direct
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\MyProject'; & 'C:\Users\ntdoi\AppData\Roaming\Python\Python313\Scripts\git-filter-repo.exe' --path .env --path .env.production --path .env.example --path .env.production.example --path backend/.env --path backend/.env.production --path backend/.env.example --path backend/.env.production.example --path frontend/.env --path frontend/.env.production --path frontend/.env.example --path frontend/.env.production.example --invert-paths --force

tasks.label: restore-remote-and-push-force
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\MyProject'; git remote add origin git@github.com:thanhdoiit96-cyber/StockPilot.git; git remote -v; git --no-pager status --short; git push --force-with-lease origin main

tasks.label: sync-remote-ref-and-push
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\MyProject'; git fetch origin main; git push --force-with-lease origin main

tasks.label: verify-sequelize-pg-compat

tasks.label: verify-sequelize-pg-compat-fixed
